patterns.note: Magazine-style grid layout combining large hero images, multi-column article grids, and full-width content blocks to present diverse content.
Prominent, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for main headings and section titles, creating a strong editorial and impactful visual feel.
High contrast black text on white backgrounds, with occasional full-width dark sections to break visual rhythm and highlight specific content blocks.
A persistent, sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Alternating full-width content blocks, some featuring large editorial imagery and others with dark backgrounds and prominent text, creating distinct visual breaks and content hierarchy.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport during scroll, ensuring navigation is always accessible without any additional animation.

Content sections are structured using a flexible grid system, allowing for varied layouts from full-width images to multi-column article displays, adapting to different content types and creating a dynamic editorial spread.

Visual hierarchy is established through a stark contrast in typography, utilizing an oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif for headlines against a clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and meta information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) for section titles, with smaller, clean body text and tiny uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle radius on image cards and buttons, maintaining a clean yet approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with airy vertical spacing between main content blocks and a tighter grid within article sections, creating a structured yet open feel.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its magazine-style layout, blending large editorial images with structured article grids and bold, minimalist typography. The use of full-bleed imagery and alternating dark/light sections creates a strong visual rhythm, reminiscent of a sophisticated print publication.
